text: For a binary in a circular orbit with orbital frequency f_orbital, this book states the emitted gravitational-wave frequency f_GW is:
explanation: The book shows the mass quadrupole tensor of a circular binary oscillates at twice the orbital frequency (2Ω), so f_GW = 2 f_orbital. This is why LIGO detects binaries at ~35–150 Hz while they orbit at ~17–75 Hz. It is a quadrupole effect, not the naive equality f_GW = f_orbital.
